name: Height-Based Procedural Coloring with Approximate Lighting
definition: Applies discrete color bands based on vertex distance from a center point, normalized by a planet radius, and approximates directional lighting using distance differences.
summary: Height-Based Procedural Coloring with Approximate Lighting assigns discrete color bands to volumes based on normalized radial distance from a center point, using a simplified lighting model that approximates directional illumination through hardcoded light source distance comparisons.
